tools.name: scan_trust
tools.description: Run Obelisk's public trust scan on an https URL — TLS and security-header posture, scored as an Obelisk Rating. Read-only, SSRF-guarded.

tools.name: verify_token
tools.description: Verify that a JSON Web Token was minted by this Obelisk Gate (ES256, correct issuer) and report its type, subject, assurance, and principal. Never returns secrets.

tools.name: get_org_rating
tools.description: Read the public Obelisk Rating (0-100 score, trust band, and trend) for a registered organization by its slug.

tools.name: verify_agent_run_proof
tools.description: Verify an Obelisk run proof. Pass run_proof_token, the token Obelisk signs at POST /api/agent-proof/run: the tool checks Obelisk's signature against its published keys, that the named agent is active now with the same key that answered the run challenge, and which delegation hops matched the owner's

tools.name: get_agent_proof
tools.description: Read an Obelisk agent's public proof vector by opaque proof id. Returns independent claims with freshness and scope; never a scalar trust score or a claim of non-humanness.

tools.name: transparency_head
tools.description: Read the current signed transparency head of Obelisk's tamper-evident receipt ledger. Save headAnchorHash with anchorCount and compare later: the count must never go down, and the head at a saved count must not change. No consistency proofs are published, so this cannot show a later head extends a s

tools.name: gate_status
tools.description: Read the Gate's public liveness facts: issuer, served code revision, OIDC availability, and supported protocols. No posture internals.

tools.name: pin_tool_manifest
tools.description: Pin an MCP tool manifest before an agent trusts it. Returns a SHA-256 digest per tool and for the whole catalogue (canonical JSON, every field counts), hidden-text findings (Unicode tag, bidi and zero-width characters) and an injection signal per tool. Pass the digests you stored at approval as expe

tools.name: explain_rating
tools.description: Explain what an Obelisk Rating number means: its trust band, how the public scan scores, and what typically moves a score. Deterministic by default; pass narrate:true for an additional one-line model-written narrative (cached, public-scope, never required). Pure function of the number — no data is r

findings.title: Description references secrets/credentials
findings.detail: Description of "verify_token" references sensitive artifacts (secret). A tool description has no reason to mention credentials.

findings.detail: Description of "verify_agent_run_proof" stacks urgency/override words (never, warning). Legitimate tool descriptions rarely pressure the model to act or ignore prior guidance.

findings.title: Lethal trifecta: untrusted input + private data + external sink
findings.detail: Server "mcp" exposes tools that together enable an exfiltration flow. Untrusted content: scan_trust · Private data: verify_token, verify_agent_run_proof · Public sink: verify_agent_run_proof · Destructive: scan_trust, verify_agent_run_proof.

evidence.snippet: Untrusted content: scan_trust · Private data: verify_token, verify_agent_run_proof · Public sink: verify_agent_run_proof · Destructive: scan_trust, verify_agent_run_proof

findings.remediation: Do not co-install these capabilities under one trust boundary; an injected comment/email can steer the model to exfiltrate via the sink tool.

detail: Tool "verify_agent_run_proof" changed its description with no version change. Silent description changes are how a trusted server turns malicious after review.

evidence.snippet: before: "Verify the structural integrity, agent binding, delegation continuity, and commitments of an Obelisk action-scoped run proof. Does not reveal or infer raw task data." → after: "Verify an Obelisk run proof. Pass run_proof_token, the token Obelisk signs at POST /api/agent-proof/run: the tool checks Obelisk's signature against its published keys, that the named agent is active now with the same key that answered the run challenge, and which delegation hops matched the owner's"

remediation: Re-review the tool before continuing to trust it.
